description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.

summary.one_liner: Roo Code is a TypeScript AI coding assistant extension for code editors that offers multiple agent modes for writing, refactoring, debugging, and documenting code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Roo Code as an AI-powered dev team inside your editor. It lists capabilities including generating code from natural language descriptions and specs, refactoring and debugging existing code, writing and updating documentation, answering questions about a codebase, automating repetitive tasks, and using MCP servers. It is organized around five modes: Code (everyday edits and file operations), Architect (planning systems, specs, and migrations), Ask (answers and explanations), Debug (tracing issues and isolating root causes), and Custom Modes for specialized workflows. The README also notes that the Roo Code extension was shut down on May 15th and points to ZooCode and Cline as alternatives, so the project's current status is uncertain. The README does not include installation or run instructions.
use_cases: Generate code from natural language specs
notable: Multiple agent modes: Code, Architect, Ask, Debug, plus user-defined Custom Modes
Originated from the Cline project, according to the README
